description: Read this once before you add or shape the data of a report: how to send a CSV or an Excel workbook and pick the range of a sheet, how to check a figure with queryReportData, how to shape data with previewReportDatasheetChanges, renderReportSlides and saveReportDatasheetChanges, and the query model those changes write. It needs no report. With stepFunctions, it also answers the exact params of those step functions, for the steps after a join.

query.description: Options for the call, such as filters, paging or how long to wait

stepFunctions.description: Step functions whose exact params to answer with the guide, for the steps after a join: repeat the parameter for each, as in `?stepFunctions=filter&stepFunctions=sort`.

name: getReportDataGuide
title: Get the data guide
